treatment: Dramatist winner 'The Slot Without an Edge', restaged after Gates 0B to 0D. A FACELESS gunmetal letterbox in the street door of a state office in Juneau on a rain-black night has always taken any question, even a spoken balloon. The proposed rule is a sheet of tracing vellum clipped beside the slot, a pencilled form-shaped outline whose fourth edge is a dashed line, pencilled bolt circles, a DRAFT tab and a BLANK hang tag. A service envelope and Tote the courier robot stop and wait at the pencil line (the reported verb, submitting through), a person drafts with an ice-cyan phone helper, fixes its mistake and carries the note to the slot where it presses at the dashed edge, neither in nor out. The crane through the slot shows the volume caps as a DRAFT tape line, a candle and an hour meter. Two same-size cards on the railing hold the residents draft and the statute's words, level, no verdict. The night clerk works the stack in a warm room for the fair case. The signature is the door in cross-section: one real stack stops at the 250 line beside a dashed ghost of Tote's, labelled VOLUME, A KNOWN PERSON and WHAT DOES THE TOOL LINE ADD?. The button holds the balloon at the threshold.

palette.divergence: 11-13 had a brass faucet WITH A FACE on overcast daylight gravel and a mint-AI tomato-rule accent grammar; this film is night, a FACELESS gunmetal letterbox, pencil-grey vellum for the rule and glacier-cyan only on screens for AI. 11-14 had a nameplate on its hero and two equal signs; here the rule is visibly a draft and the comparison has one real stack and one dashed ghost. shape_language: The letterbox, the balloon and the people are ROUNDED: open, the way a request is today. Everything PROPOSED is HARD and RECTILINEAR but only PENCILLED on vellum (crisp corners, rx 4 or less), dashed, never inked or fastened. The one shape that never resolves is the cutout's fourth edge, dashed. Tote is a compact rounded box so it sits with the soft side.

casting.hero: Flap (lib/recordslot.tsx), cast FACELESS (face={false}): a gunmetal door letterbox whose flap is the one moving part. Reason: the angle needs the CHANNEL drawn as a thing you can watch; the people carry the emotion, so the fixture is not a talking character like 11-13's faucet. Its `faceplate` prop now draws the PROPOSED rule as a clipped tracing-vellum template with a pencilled outline, pencilled bolt circles, a DRAFT tab and a BLANK hang tag; `sketch` pencils the outline in.
casting.ai_presence: Tote (lib/recordslot.tsx), a graphite courier robot with a glacier-cyan screen face that only ever carries and is only ever shown WAITING at the pencil line or as a dashed ghost IF ALLOWED, never let in. Plus a phone helper face (glacier-cyan) that drafts while the person sends.
casting.supporting: The requester in a rain shell (awning, street, over-shoulder) and the night clerk in a warm room, both the episode's own figures wrapped in IdleFigure and FigureFinish, carry the feeling. The Question balloon and note is the throughline.
casting.freshness: dedupe hero Flap (new). Last two heroes Drip, RingedSeal.

motion_language: Rain never stops, in two planes, so no outdoor frame is still. The vellum lifts and settles as the binder clips snap; a pencil sketches its outline on; the bolt circles are drawn, never fired. The letterbox's only life is breath, the flap's swing, the gulp squash and the travelling lip glint. The people carry the acting: the requester trims, fixes, carries and hesitates; the clerk lifts pages and turns the placard. Papers land with a squash and settle; Tote rolls with wheel spin and a satchel swing and stops to wait. Motion blur on the balloon's drift, the crane through the slot and the stack's drop. At most three frame kicks on the board.

composition.signature_shot: Shot 13 'Same line', beat ids 39 to 42 (keys 36, 37, 44, 38), 102.94 to 115.38 s: the door in cross-section; a stack of hand-filled official forms posted by a gloved hand drops to the 250 tape line beside a dashed ghost of Tote's labelled IF ALLOWED, then VOLUME, A KNOWN PERSON IF A PORTAL IS REQUIRED and TOOL LINE light in turn and the blank tag swings into the middle; the question note stays out of both stacks.
composition.framing: whenever the template is up the letterbox sits at x 400 to 450 so letterbox plus template plus tag stays inside x 60 to 1020

practicals: Every draft provision says PROPOSED and carries PER JUNEAU EMPIRE once per group. The REASON tag stays BLANK all film. Nothing is ever shown refused or let in by the draft: the service envelope, Tote and the note WAIT at the pencil line; Tote's stack is a dashed ghost IF ALLOWED. c19 lives on its own placard in the clerk's room. No meter shows a zero or FREE. c15 and c16 sit on two same-size cards at the same height and light with no verdict mark, and c16's card carries WITH EXCEPTIONS. The button holds the balloon at the threshold, it never sails through.
